sections.theory:
Exercise questions

1. Choose and write the suitable answers.

i. Flame-giving things include fuel, liquids, gunpowder and ________ .

(a) ink  (b) paint  (c) syrup  (d) water

ii. In the home, protection from fire starts first with ________ .

(a) guest room  (b) bedrooms  (c) kitchen  (d) courtyard

iii. At night the quantity of ________ in the air decreases.

(a) carbon dioxide  (b) nitrogen  (c) hydrogen  (d) oxygen

iv. The place and quantity of flame-giving things should be kept ________ .

(a) limited  (b) wide  (c) supervision  (d) different

v. Before constructing a building ________ is very necessary.

(a) instructions  (b) map  (c) planning  (d) papers

vi. For fire to burn heat, oxygen and ________ are needed.

(a) water  (b) electricity  (c) environment  (d) fuel

vii. At workplaces there should be a proper arrangement of ________ .

(a) residence  (b) electricity  (c) security  (d) wall

viii. There are ________ methods of artificial respiration.

(a) 2  (b) 3  (c) 4  (d) one
